title: Platform: File system syscall wrappers (getdents64, open, read)

context_files.reason: Syscall security: path validation, buffer bounds

acceptance_criteria: fs_open(path, flags) wraps open syscall with O_RDONLY | O_DIRECTORY
fs_read(fd, buffer, count) wraps read syscall
fs_getdents64(fd, buffer, count) wraps getdents64 syscall (syscall 217)
fs_stat(path, stat_buf) wraps stat or fstat syscall
All wrappers handle errors and return -errno on failure
Buffer size constants defined (64KB for getdents64 batch buffer)
Unit test verifies opening /tmp, reading entries, and closing
